evidence.quote: Grafting moves from late March, as the 1 October call set it, to the second half of February.

observations.why: Rescheduling future orchard grafting from March to February specifies a concrete upcoming operational plan.

evidence.quote: last year's February trial row took at twice the rate of the March grafts

observations.why: Grounds the decision in concrete empirical data and historical performance from the previous year's trial.
